sentences.japanese: 空気の場合、大気中には常にある程度の湿気があるが、その量が大幅に増えると光の波に影響してくる。
sentences.english: As for the air, there is always some moisture in the atmosphere, but when the amount increases a great deal, it affects the light waves.

sentences.japanese: 近頃日本の帰国子女が増えている。
sentences.english: The number of Japanese students returning after life abroad has been increasing as of late.

sentences.japanese: 近頃外国旅行をする人がだんだん増えている。
sentences.english: These days more and more people are traveling abroad.

sentences.japanese: 近頃は海外旅行を経験する若い日本人が増えた。
sentences.english: Many young Japanese travel overseas these days.

sentences.japanese: 近ごろ、少年犯罪が増えた。
sentences.english: Recently juvenile delinquency has been on the rise.
